mapper.select:
SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbsmomListMapper : 자녀맘터치법*/ count(*) FROM ( SELECT AA.BBSCTT_CN AS BBSCTT_CN , AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID , AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT , AA.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT , BB.RETE_ESNTAL_NO AS RETE_ESNTAL_NO , '1' AS NUM FROM AYE100 AS AA ,AYE120 AS BB WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD(+) = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO(+) = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%'
AND AA.FRST_RGTR_ID LIKE '%'||#{FRST_RGTR_ID}||'%'
AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}||'%'
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{STARTDATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{ENDDATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
UNION ALL SELECT BB.RETE_CN AS BBSCTT_CN , BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , BB.RETE_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM , BB.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID , BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT , BB.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT , BB.RETE_ESNTAL_NO AS RETE_ESNTAL_NO , '2' AS NUM FROM AYE120 AS BB ,AYE100 AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD(+) = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO(+) = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IS NOT NULL
AND BB.RETE_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%' /*게시글제목명*/
AND BB.FRST_RGTR_ID LIKE '%'||#{FRST_RGTR_ID}||'%' /*작성자명*/
AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}||'%' /*게시글번호*/
AND BB.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{STARTDATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND BB.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{ENDDATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
) AS EE ORDER BY EE.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ASC , EE.NUM

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbsmomListMapper : 자녀맘터치법(조회) (전체)*/ AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글 고유번호 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글 제목명 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /* 작성자명 */ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS WRTR_ID /* 작성자아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRT_DT /* 작성일자 */ , CC.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD /* 위기유형구분명 */ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT , (SELECT MAX(BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) FROM AYE110 BB /* 댓글 */ WHERE BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT /* 상담원명 */ , (SELECT MAX(BB.FRST_RGTR_ID ) FROM AYE110 BB /* 댓글 */ WHERE BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담원아이디 */ , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE110 BB /* 댓글 */ WHERE BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS REPLY_CNT /* 댓글수 */ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD) AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD --문제상태대분류구분코드 , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD) AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD --문제원인대분류구분코드 FROM AYE100 AA , SAC100 CC
WHERE 1=1 AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL ) AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' /* 게시판유형구분코드 */ AND CC.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) = 'CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD' /* 위기유형구분코드 */ AND CC.CMMNS_CD_VALUE(+) = AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD
AND AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = #{CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 위기유형구분 조회 */
AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} || '%' /* 게시글 고유번호 조회 */
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_TTL_NM} || '%' /* 게시글 제목 조회 */
AND C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) LIKE '%' || #{WRTR_NM_ENCPT} || '%' /* 작성자 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD IS NULL /* 문제상태미등록 */
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
ORDER BY AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO DESC , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbsmomListMapper : 자녀맘터치법(조회)미답변*/ AA.BBSCTT_CN AS BBSCTT_CN , AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID , AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT , '1' AS NUM , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT , ( SELECT A1.INDEX_SN FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ) AS INDEX_SN /*상담자배정일련번호*/ , ( SELECT A1.CONSTT_NM_ENCPT FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ) AS CONSTT_NM_ENCPT /*상담사*/ , ( SELECT A1.CONSTT_ID FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ) AS CONSTT_ID /*상담원아이디*/ FROM AYE100 AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'Y' FROM AYE120 BB WHERE AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' )
AND ( SELECT A1.CONSTT_ID FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ) = #{LOGIN_ID}
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%' /*게시글제목명*/
AND AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT LIKE '%'||#{WRTR_NM_ENCPT}||'%' /*작성자명*/
AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} /*게시글번호*/
AND AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = #{CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD}
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{STARTDATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{ENDDATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(BB.FLNM_ENCPT) AS NAME /* 상담원명, 상담원아이디 */ , CC.USER_ID AS USER_ID /* 상담원아이디 */ FROM AYC100 AA , SCA100 BB , SAA200 CC WHERE 1=1 AND AA.WORK_YMD = #{WORKYMD} AND AA.USER_ID = CC.USER_ID AND BB.ENFSN_NO = CC.ENFSN_NO

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbsmomListMapper : 자녀맘터치법(상세)*/ AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /*제목*/ , AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글번호*/ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID /*작성자아이디*/ , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자*/ , AA.BRTH_YMD AS BRTH_YMD /*출생일자*/ , AA.RDCNT_NOCS AS RDCNT_NOCS /*조회수*/ , to_char(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일자*/ , ( SELECT A1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SXDC_SE_CD' AND A1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.SXDC_SE_CD ) AS SXDC_SE_CD /*성별*/ , AA.NTABRD_PSWD_ENCPT AS NTABRD_PSWD_ENCPT /*글비번*/ , AA.CNTN_IP_ADDR AS CNTN_IP_ADDR /*아이피주소*/ , AA.BBSCTT_CN AS BBSCTT_CN /*게시글내용*/ , ( SELECT to_char(A1.REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} ) AS REG_DT /*상담자배정일자*/ , ( SELECT A1.CONSTT_ID FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} ) AS CONSTT_ID /*상담사명, 메모*/ , ( SELECT A1.MEMO_NM FROM AYA160 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} ) AS MEMO_NM /*상담사명, 메모*/ FROM AYE100 AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' /*삭제여부*/ AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}
mapper.update: UPDATE AYE100 SET /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbsmomListMapper : 자녀맘터치법(수정)*/ BBSCTT_TTL_NM = #{BBSCTT_TTL_NM} /*게시글제목명*/ ,BBSCTT_CN = #{BBSCTT_CN} /*게시글내용*/ ,LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} ,LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}
mapper.select:
SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbsmomListMapper : 자녀맘터치법(답글상세)*/ ATFINO /*파일명*/ , CNTN_IP_ADDR /*아이피번호*/ , FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록아이디*/ , RETE_CN /*답글내용*/ , RETE_TTL_NM /*답글제목*/ , C##RG.DEC_B64(WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자명*/ , RETE_ESNTAL_NO /*답글고유번호*/ , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글고유번호*/ FROM AYE120 /*답글테이블*/ WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' AND DEL_YN = 'N'
AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} -->
mapper.insert:
SELECT AYA150_SQ01.CURRVAL AS INDEX_SN FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO AYA150 (/*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbsmomListMapper : 자녀맘터치법()*/ INDEX_SN /*일련번호*/ , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글고유번호*/ , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글유형구분코드*/ , CONSTT_ID /*상담자아이디*/ , CONSTT_NM_ENCPT /*상다자명*/ , USE_YN /*사용여부*/ , REG_DT /*등록일시*/ , DEL_YN /*삭제여부*/ , FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록아이디*/ , FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일*/ , LAST_MDFR_ID /*최종수정아이디*/ , LAST_MDFCN_DT /*최종수정일*/ ) VALUES ( AYA150_SQ01.NEXTVAL /*일련번호*/ , #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} /*게시글고유번호*/ , '15' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ , #{CONSTT_ID} /*상담자아이디*/ , (SELECT DD.FLNM_ENCPT FROM SAA200 AS CC , SCA100 AS DD WHERE 1=1 AND #{CONSTT_ID} = CC.USER_ID AND CC.ENFSN_NO = DD.ENFSN_NO AND DD.DEL_YN = 'N' ) , 'Y' /*사용여부*/ , #{REG_DT} /*등록일시*/ , 'N' /*삭제여부*/ , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} /*최초등록아이디*/ , SYSDATE /*최초등록일*/ , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /*최종수정아이디*/ , SYSDATE /*최종수정일*/ )
mapper.update: UPDATE AYA150 SET /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbsmomListMapper : 자녀맘터치법()*/ CONSTT_ID = #{CONSTT_ID} , CONSTT_NM_ENCPT = (SELECT DD.FLNM_ENCPT FROM SAA200 AS CC , SCA100 AS DD WHERE 1=1 AND #{CONSTT_ID} = CC.USER_ID AND CC.ENFSN_NO = DD.ENFSN_NO AND DD.DEL_YN = 'N' ) , REG_DT = #{REG_DT} , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' AND INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN__origin}
mapper.select: SELECT INDEX_SN /*일련번호*/ , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글고유번호*/ , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글유형구분코드*/ , CONSTT_ID /*상담자아이디*/ , CONSTT_NM_ENCPT /*상다자명*/ , USE_YN /*사용여부*/ , REG_DT /*등록일시*/ , DEL_YN /*삭제여부*/ , FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록아이디*/ , FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일*/ , LAST_MDFR_ID /*최종수정아이디*/ , LAST_MDFCN_DT /*최종수정일*/ FROM AYA150 WHERE 1=1 AND INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN}
SELECT RFRNC_NO , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , CONSTT_ID , MEMO_NM FROM AYA160 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15'
mapper.insert: INSERT /* isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbscttListMapper.insertMemo : 자녀맘터치법 메모등록 */ INTO AYA160 ( RFRNC_NO , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , CONSTT_ID , MEMO_NM , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( ( SELECT NVL(MAX(RFRNC_NO),0)+1 FROM AYA160 ) , #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} , '15' , #{CONSTT_ID} , #{MEMO_NM} , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} , SYSDATE , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , SYSDATE )
